title: Absolute derived tensor comparison after point evaluation
statement: Let X be a scheme whose O_X-module category admits a derived category. Let e be a point-evaluation equivalence for the global sections point and P an additive strong monoidal left adjoint from Γ(X,O_X)-modules to O_X-modules with the prescribed inverse-image and change-of-rings object and morphism formulas. There exist an absolute total left derived functor L and comparison α, invertible on K-flat complexes, and bifunctorial tensor isomorphisms δ. On every pair of K-flat representatives the equation L(μ_Qh) followed by α at their tensor followed by Qh of the totalized inverse ordinary tensor constraint equals δ followed by the tensor of the two α components followed by μ_Qh. The notions are those of def-pc-global-derived-rhom, lem-pc-ringed-space-tensor-pullback-absolute, lem-pc-kflat-pullback-preservation and def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure. It asserts neither existence nor a counit normalization of the underived functor.

source.place: Lemma 20.27.3; Tags 0FP0, 06YJ, 06XN for normalization and absolute derivation

proof.text: Use lem-sc-global-tensor-pullback-kflat to obtain preservation of K-flat homotopy objects and inversion of quasi-isomorphisms between them by P^h followed by Qh. The upstream K-flat localizer is a left derivability structure supplied by functorial flat resolutions. Its Derives.hasLeftDerivedFunctor constructs the universal derived pair L and alpha, and Derives.isIso_of_isLeftDerivedFunctor computes it on K-flat objects.

After any postcomposition H, alpha is still invertible on K-flat objects, since functors preserve isomorphisms. LocalizerMorphism.isLeftDerivedFunctor_of_isLeftDerivabilityStructure then proves the requested postcomposition property directly. The quotient K-flat criterion supplies the cochain computation clause.

Apply normalized tensor descent to the constructed L and alpha. Its hypotheses are comparison invertibility on the K-flat resolving class and preservation of K-flatness by Ph. This supplies simultaneous tensor naturality and the exact normalization on quotient cochain objects.
